poses.caption: Sit tall with straight legs in a wide angle, feet flexed and hands just behind your hips for support.
Lean forward gently from your hips with a long back until you feel the hamstrings stretch. Hold for a few breaths, then return upright.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical illustration canonical1587 SEATED WIDE ANGLE POSE SEQUENCE. TWO equal square cells side by side WIDE2:1 landscape same full body person scale FRONT three-quarter view. Seated pelvis grounded on thin gray mat, BOTH legs STRAIGHT spread in wide V about90degrees, kneecaps and toes point UP, heels resting mat, ankles DORSIFLEXED. BOTH palms on mat JUST BEHIND hips fingers to sides, elbows softly bent providing support, hands stay reachable and visible at hips not far behind. LEFT START torso TALL VERTICAL neutral spine long neck shoulders relaxed. RIGHT FINISH hinge forward MODESTLY about20degrees FROM HIPS toward midpoint between legs, back LONG STRAIGHT not rounded, neck aligned, pelvis grounded feet unchanged. Hands remain on mat just behind hips, elbows accommodate lean, no impossible long arms. This is gentle small forward fold not lying face down. Primary BILATERAL POSTERIOR THIGH HAMSTRINGS RED where visible below shorts; upper covered posterior thighs only subtle DIFFUSE red tint on intact shorts. Not front quadriceps/inner adductors/calves red. Fabric opaque smooth cloth with broad folds NO muscle fibers/lobes through shorts. Fine detailed grayscale other EXPOSED anatomy realistic fingers proportions feet. Full opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK and BLACK MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH completely as legs spread continuous hems/seams no cutaways/transparency. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins entire head hands widest heels mat inside EACH square uncropped. Equal male/female quality.
